original.revision: 01.00 (from the Killzone Trilogy disc's PS3_EXTRA package)

approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and SPU code to C++ with ps3recomp v0.18.0 and this project's patches, HLE system libraries, Vulkan RSX backend
help: Testing on other GPUs (AMD, Intel) and CPUs
Testing on a clean Windows machine
Playing levels 2 to 11 to their end
notes: Needs your own copy of the game (the Killzone HD package from the Killzone Trilogy disc, decrypted EBOOT and archive, and libsre from your own PS3 firmware); the build happens on your PC. Playable: Level 1 played to its end, all 11 levels load; 60 fps by default, an optional 144 Hz mode.
